boundary: Twelve sequential independent authenticated SSH connections in balanced fixed order. Matching client/cloud budgets in each block, 10 idle + 10 loaded + 10 recovery samples. Repeated SHA-256-verified resident cat payloads; all blocks and bytes complete. No agent input or application replacement. Background traffic uncontrolled; not a same-connection trial or a UI scrolling/typing test.

provenance.clock: Mac UTC timestamps and monotonic elapsed RTT; no cross-host clock subtraction
provenance.scope: Singapore-to-US protocol RTT and completed application payload throughput; not US-local or rendered-input latency

server.evidence: GCP inventory checked around 2026-11-16T12:04Z; exact runtime placement not re-resolved for each block

provenance.settings: All variants retain 2 KiB bursts, interactive priority, 16 KiB socket credit and dynamic terminal window 8-64 KiB. Dynamic window derives from each variant's total rate. TCP output guard remains default-off. Broker directories isolate test budgets from production tokens; host network still shared.
provenance.source: e53f4ba5c0228ba643e5e5269953c9e9dd7dc80b exported from Git for all variants; only scheduler defaults and cloud diagnostic broker directory differ
provenance.workload: profile-ssh-latency -load-mode command -samples 10; repeated verified payloads through cat

runs.boundary: One authenticated Go SSH connection; exact resident ping, equal-size guest echo and gateway keepalive. Load runs cat through the production resident command adapter, verifies binary stdin/stdout SHA-256 and requires successful exit status. verified_load_bytes counts received bytes; verified_upload_bytes counts matching uploaded bytes. No claim of Mutagen or installed-daemon coverage.
